parts.title: Our Cardboard Ship
parts.text: Zara, Owen, and Luis built a **rocket** from big cardboard boxes. They drew a red button and a blinking control panel with markers. Zara wanted to be an **astronaut** when she grew up. “Let’s visit a faraway **planet**,” said Owen. Luis climbed in and began the **countdown**. “Ten, nine, eight...”

parts.title: Blast Off
parts.text: “Three, two, one!” At zero, the ship would **launch**. Owen made a loud **blast** sound with his mouth, and a dog barked from the porch. The children pretended to float in their seats. They felt **weightless**, just like real space travelers.

parts.title: Among the Stars
parts.text: Out the window, they saw a **distant** light. “A **comet**!” cried Zara. Luis pointed at a **constellation** shaped like a bear. A **glimmer** of silver came from a **mysterious** moon rock. Everyone stayed quiet to watch it shine.

parts.title: Home Again
parts.text: Then Mom called them for dinner. The ship was only boxes, but the trip had felt real. Luis folded the boxes and set them by the door. They promised to fly again tomorrow.
